title: Design meh not impressed
text: I got my first shirt and it was a huge let down. The design is small and only on one side. The shirt is white and picks up stains easily. Hoping the October shirt will be cooler or I'm definitely cancelling. I'd rather get a shirt in pink every month with a better, larger design. I love Hello Kitty and was hoping for way cuter like in the email ad sanrio sent me  This is so cheap. Meh.
label: neutral
